name: Incentive For The Intra Caste Marriage within Scheduled Tribe Community
benefit: An incentive of ₹2,00,000/- is provided to the married couple.
_eligibility_text:
1. The couple should be residing in Karnataka.
1. Both the partners should be from the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community but from different sub-castes.
1. The combined annual income of the couple must be less than ₹2,00,000/-.
1. The couple must apply to this scheme within one year of their marriage.
1. The marriage should have taken place on or after 1st April 2018.
